Subject: Initial PO packet + onboarding forms for marketplace listing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to proceed with listing Redwood via AWS Marketplace for our org. Procurement asked me to send the initial packet so we can get a PO over the next week. Attached is a short request form that includes our billing entity and preferred payment terms (CloudIntegrate Inc., US entity).

Can you confirm the exact documents Redwood needs to accept a PO from our side? Specifically:
- Do you need a W-9 / tax certificate or can you accept VAT exemption (we may have mixed EU/US entities later)?
- Any specific PO template fields you need (address, remit-to, contact)?
- Do you accept signed POs via email or do you require DocuSign?

I attached: CloudIntegrate_PoRequest_0720.pdf (PO request + billing contact stub). Procurement is procurement@cloudintegrate.com — feel free to loop them in. We’d like to get a purchase order executed by next Wednesday (7/26) if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO packet + onboarding forms for marketplace listing

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Quick checklist so we can unblock the procurement flow on our side:

Required for PO processing (minimum):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we can accept your CloudIntegrate_PoRequest as a starter, but we’ll need remit-to + tax ID)
- W-9 (for US entity) or W-8 / local tax form for non-US entities
- Billing contact name + email + phone, and an AP email that receives invoices

Marketplace / activation specifics:
- For AWS Marketplace listings we need the exact billing entity (legal name) to map to the SKU and invoice flow. If you want the EU entity to be billed later, we’ll need that entity’s tax docs before live.
- PO format: a signed PDF is fine; DocuSign is optional. Please ensure PO includes PO number, total, remit-to address, and expected start date.

Commercial / terms note:
- Our standard net terms for marketplace invoicing is Net 30 for enterprise customers; if you need Net45 or Net60 we’ll need a quick finance review.

Next steps from my side: I’ll route the packet to FinOps and confirm the remit-to details + whether we can accept an emailed signed PO. Looping Vanessa (billing) and Ben (seller ops) to speed approvals.

Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Finance prefers Net30 standard. If procurement is pushing for Net45, we should escalate to Finance (HS-12345). Also confirm whether they want invoice PDF or marketplace-metered billing (they mentioned a start date).

I’ll drop a finance ticket and request approval for Net45 if needed. Ben, can you verify whether the CloudIntegrate SKU we discussed requires any special mapping or if we can attach their PO to the existing listing? That will affect lead time.

—Vanessa

Sarah — received, thanks for sending the signed PO. Next steps from Redwood:

1) I’ve uploaded CI-PO-789 to our internal intake and pinged Finance to validate remit-to and Net30. Expect confirmation in 1-2 business days.
2) Finance may request a W-9 (US) — please send if available; otherwise we can provisionally map the PO and request it before invoicing.
3) We’ll complete the marketplace activation and map the billing entity to the SKU; tentative go-live window is 7–10 business days after finance clears (pending any mapping exceptions).

For the MSA and signature flow, we will send a DocuSign link for the master agreement (MSA-4728). Signing the PO via email is sufficient to start the intake, but the MSA will need an executed signature before the first invoice.

Deliverables from you (one reply with these would be perfect):
- Confirmed W-9 (or confirm if you’ll provide DUNS instead)
- Final AP email for invoicing (procurement@cloudintegrate.com)
- Any special remit-to wiring instructions (if wire required, include bank stub)

I’ll follow up once Finance confirms and when I open the HubSpot deal HS-12345 for final acceptance.

Thanks,
